title: Bathtub
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- bathtub body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='65' rx='38' ry='20' fill='#d8e8f0'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='38' ry='18' fill='#eaf4fa'/>
  <!-- tub inner -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='32' ry='13' fill='#4aa8d8'/>
  <!-- water -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='57' rx='30' ry='11' fill='#6fd0f5'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='30' ry='10' fill='#9be7ff'/>
  <!-- bubbles -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='48' r='5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='44' r='6' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='42' r='7' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='45' r='5.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='49' r='4.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='50' r='3.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='38' r='3' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='35' r='3.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <!-- bubble highlights -->
  <circle cx='29' cy='46' r='1.5' fill='#9be7ff'/>
  <circle cx='39' cy='42' r='1.8' fill='#9be7ff'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='40' r='2' fill='#9be7ff'/>
  <!-- tub rim highlight -->
  <path d='M12 60 Q50 42 88 60' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='82' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#b8ccd8'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='82' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#b8ccd8'/>
  <!-- tap / faucet -->
  <rect x='46' y='28' width='8' height='12' rx='2' fill='#e8c85a'/>
  <rect x='44' y='26' width='12' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#f5da7a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='33' r='1.5' fill='#c8a83a'/>
  <!-- water drop from tap -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='43' rx='2.5' ry='3.5' fill='#9be7ff'/>
  <!-- shine on tub -->
  <path d='M20 68 Q50 78 80 68' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
